Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 305/2023 of Police Station Hauz Qazi for offence under Section 498A/406/323/509/506/34 IPC on the ground that respondent no. 2 has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has no objection to this petition.
Respondent no.2 identified by IO/ASI Raj Kumar also accepts notice.
4. For recording statement of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 27.03.2026.
